status_reviews.segment_name: Phase II, Ganzhou South Branch (Dayu-Xinfeng Segment)
status_reviews.researcher_notes: verdict: stale. This row's own Status[ref] is a web.archive.org capture of a ccpc360.com 'bggg' URL (a tender/bid-announcement path pattern) dated 2026-05-14 in Wayback, itself citing a page apparently from 2023-08-30 — but Wayback is documented degraded today (availability API answered, capture fetch returned HTTP 429 on a single serial attempt, consistent with the measured rate-limit signature) so its actual content (which may itself already describe construction/bidding rather than a mere proposal) could not be re-read. Independent circumstantial evidence points the same direction: the 2022 CCXI credit-rating report for 江西省天然气集团有限公司 (qxb_rating.pdf/ccxi.pdf, footnote 3 + body text) states the Phase II network (管道分公司, which explicitly includes Dayu county in its footnote-3 county list) had, as of March 2022, completed 5.045B yuan of investment with '二期管网工程大部分支线均已开工完成...剩余部分预计2023年底完工' (most Phase II branches already under construction, remainder expected complete by end of 2023) — i.e. BEFORE the wiki's own 2023-08-30 'proposed' status date. That is a real inconsistency (a branch reported >90% likely under construction or complete by a date the wiki still calls 'proposed'), but I could not obtain a segment-specific 2024+ source confirming a new status for THIS branch specifically (Dayu-Xinfeng), so verdict is 'stale' (evidence is old / likely superseded) rather than 'change' (no confirmed replacement status). Recommend a human re-check once Wayback access recovers, and/or a targeted search for a 2024-2026 completion-acceptance notice for 赣州南支线(大余-信丰段).
